# Local dev overrides — loaded by `wrangler dev` automatically
# Override authenticated mode so requests don't require login tokens
DEPLOYMENT_MODE=local_trusted
DEPLOYMENT_PLATFORM=cloudflare
DEPLOYMENT_EXPOSURE=private

# Sidecar = the local Node server (runs plugin jobs, etc.)
# Set to the running dev server; leave blank if not needed locally
SIDECAR_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3101
SIDECAR_API_KEY=dev-local
---gitignore---
(no .gitignore in deploy-cloudflare)
7:.env
